svg.title: Phased-array angle-of-arrival DSP pipeline
svg.desc: Signal flow from a multichannel source through a sub-sample delay model, Hann window, radix-2/Bluestein RFFT, GCC-PHAT cross-correlation and peak search to a least-squares angle-of-arrival fit.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pure-Python DSP for SDR & acoustic arrays · hand-rolled FFT · GCC-PHAT · least-squares AoA
